item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00107","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C02","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the later letter. Both concern U.S. support for the Diem government in Viet-Nam, connect American aid to governmental reform and effective performance, and present that support as a means of creating a stable, independent state resistant to Communist subversion or aggression. The child updates C10's prospective, conditional offer by reporting progress, citing Diem's reform programs, and affirming continued and expanded support. C02 has some parallel diplomatic language about gratifying progress, stability, and continued U.S. interest, while C25 similarly explains foreign assistance in anti-aggression terms, but neither approaches C10's target-specific and substantive correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It is gratifying to learn from him of the distinct progress that is being made in Viet-Nam by Prime Minister Diem and the Government of Viet-Nam.","parent_excerpt":"We have been exploring ways and means to permit our aid to VietNam to be more effective and to make a greater contribution to the welfare and stability of the Government of Viet-Nam.","explanation":"Both letters assess the effectiveness and stability of the same government as the basis for American assistance."},{"child_excerpt":"The Prime Minister's announced programs of land reform and reorganization of the Armed Forces should, when fully carried out, further increase the stability and unity of the Government.","parent_excerpt":"The Government of the United States expects that this aid will be met by performance on the part of the Government of Viet-Nam in undertaking needed reforms.","explanation":"The child concretely reports the reform performance that C10 made an expected condition and objective of aid."},{"child_excerpt":"Accordingly, I have concurred in General Collins' recommendation to continue and expand support for Free Viet-Nam.","parent_excerpt":"I am, accordingly, instructing the American Ambassador to Viet-Nam to examine with you...how an intelligent program of American aid given directly to your Government can serve to assist Viet-Nam in its present hour of trial","explanation":"The matching transition and operative decision show the later letter extending the earlier aid initiative."},{"child_excerpt":"The Government of the United States is vigorously opposed to the forces of world Communism...The United States Government intends to continue its support of his Government.","parent_excerpt":"The purpose of this offer is to assist the Government of Viet-Nam in developing and maintaining a strong, viable state, capable of resisting attempted
